title: Mathematical Formulas & Computations Compendium
lede: A unified mathematical index documenting every formula, algebraic equation, and statistical distribution in the EvoSim system.

items.name: Maximum Health (MaxHP)
items.notes: Ensures high endurance species can sustain significant physical trauma before dying.

items.name: Maximum Energy (MaxEP)
items.notes: Determines total movement budget before exhaustion sets in.

items.name: Movement Energy Cost (C_move)

variables.meaning: Terrain movement multiplier (Plains: 1.0, Forest: 1.5, Jungle: 2.0, Swamp: 1.8)

items.notes: High agility substantially mitigates traversal penalties across dense terrain biomes.

items.name: Melee Combat Damage (D_combat)
items.notes: Clamped at minimum 5 damage so attacks always produce tangible impact.

items.name: Evasion Probability (P_evade)
items.notes: Capped at 75% to prevent complete invulnerability.

items.name: Stochastic Check Function

variables.meaning: Relevant biological attribute (STR, AGI, END, INT)

items.notes: Resolves situational challenges like rockslides, environmental hazards, and relic investigations.

items.name: Composite Fitness Equation

variables.meaning: Total turns survived before death or epoch end
Number of rival agents defeated in combat
Total distance traveled across unique tiles
Count of weekly environmental disasters endured

items.notes: Higher fitness directly increases selection odds in the generational roulette wheel.
